q: In January 2024, what was the nightly lodging cap for a trip to a band B destination? Answer under the version of the overseas per-diem that was in force on that date.
log:
January 2024 is before 2024-07-01, so the oldest version, `overseas-rates`, applies. It's not listed in the top level of expense, so it is probably inside travel-expense.

OPEN travel-expense
